data.title: Millions of Thais banish the booze for Buddhist Lent
data.description: SAMUT SAKHON (THAILAND) - With her palms pressed together and her head bowed, Wassana Nak-umma vowed to give up alcohol for three months, joining millions of Thais in an abstinence campaign blending public health with spirituality.

data.title: Ariana Grande withdraws from London musical, seeks to 'step back'
data.description: WASHINGTON - Pop star Ariana Grande has dropped out of what would have been her debut appearance in London's West End, the show's producers said on Sunday, as a representative for the singer said she wants to take a "step back" from the public eye.

data.title: Commonwealth Games faces uncertain future ahead of centenary edition
data.description: GLASGOW - Glasgow stepped in to save the 2026 Commonwealth Games, but a slimmed down 10-sport model over the last 10 days has failed to dispel doubts over the future of the event.

data.title: Bangkok’s Chao Phraya draws new hotels, attractions and megaprojects
data.description: Major developers are expanding hotels, attractions and mixed-use projects along the Chao Phraya as Bangkok’s riverside investment cycle accelerates

data.title: Diage Festival returns to Cloud11 in Bangkok
data.description: Diage Festival, Thailand's leading digital arts and electronic music festival, is set to return from Oct 31 to Nov 1 at Cloud11 in Bangkok, promising another immersive celebration of cutting-edge audiovisual experiences.

data.title: Chiang Mai screens Thai-Japanese film programme
data.description: Dude, Movie presents "Hearing The Voice Of Absence", a programme of eight Thai and Japanese films, at Suan Anya in Chiang Mai, from Friday to Sunday.

data.title: The power of fandom
data.description: <p>After the art toy market reached its peak, Pop Mart, a renowned character-based entertainment company, has partnered with Resorts World Sentosa (RWS) and the Singapore Tourism Board (STB) to turn its well-known characters from collectables into immersive experiences.</p>

data.title: Centre to tackle ID and civil registration fraud
data.description: The government has launched a centre to coordinate action against fraud involving civil registration records and nationality documents in a bid to curb identity-related crimes.

data.title: Record riders for school c'ship
data.description: The Thailand Equestrian Federation under the Royal Patronage, in collaboration with the Department of Physical Education (DPE), is set to host the 2026 Equestrian Inter-School Championship, to be held from Aug 12-16 at the B.Grimm Country Club, known as Thai Polo & Equestrian Club, in Pattaya.

data.title: Earthquake of magnitude 5.4 strikes Egypt
data.description: An ⁠earthquake ​measuring ​magnitude ‌5.4 struck off ​Egypt early ⁠on ‌Monday, the German ⁠Research Centre for Geosciences said.

data.title: Siam Society hosts Sarawak trip
data.description: Siam Society is holding a trip to explore the rich heritage, diverse cultures and remarkable landscapes of Sarawak, the largest state in Malaysia, from Oct 5-10.

data.title: Trump says new Iran talks set to start after calling off massive attack
data.description: WASHINGTON - US President Donald Trump said that new negotiations with Iran will begin on Monday after he decided to hold off on striking the Islamic republic to pursue a deal to end the war entering its sixth month.

data.title: Ministry looks into Mor Prom data discrepancies
data.description: An investigation into data verification and system errors within the Mor Prom mobile app will be mounted after more than 10,000 users lodged complaints regarding inaccurate medical records, the Ministry of Public Health says.

data.title: Thais urged to stay alert  for war risk
data.description: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has urged Thai nationals in the Middle East to remain vigilant as regional tensions continue to escalate and the risk of further military attacks increases.

data.title: Co-payment scheme a B86.4bn hit
data.description: The Thais Help Thais Plus 60/40 co-payment scheme generated more than 86.4 billion baht in its first two months, the government said on Sunday.

data.title: Bonds sell out in '21 seconds'
data.description: Government Savings Plus bonds sold out just 21 seconds after subscriptions opened on Friday, reflecting strong demand for secure investments amid global economic uncertainty, the government said on Sunday.

data.title: Co-pay scheme a hit, but voters unswayed
data.description: Most participants in the Thais Help Thais Plus scheme found it beneficial in reducing living costs and boosting incomes, but many remained undecided about their support for the government, according to the latest survey by Nida Poll.

data.title: Exat drafts payout criteria for bridge in Koh Chang
data.description: TRAT: The Expressway Authority of Thailand (Exat) has outlined compensation criteria for landowners affected by the proposed Koh Chang bridge as residents raised concerns that payments may not be sufficient to help them relocate, despite broad support for the project.

data.title: Twenty provinces warned of flash floods
data.description: The Office of the National Water Resources (ONWR) has warned 20 provinces to prepare for possible flash floods, forest runoff, landslides and river overflows from Aug 2-4 as heavy rain is forecast in several regions.

data.title: Lao bank seeks police inquiry
data.description: Officials from Laos, including Lao Development Bank, have asked the Central Investigation Bureau (CIB) to investigate false allegations on social media linking the bank to money laundering.
